targets.query:
from(bucket: "stackhive-telemetry")
  |> range(start: -$__fromTime)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r.hostname == "$hostname")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "stackhive-telemetry")
  |> range(start: -$__fromTime)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.hostname == "$hostname")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "stackhive-telemetry")
  |> range(start: -$__fromTime)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface_state" and r.hostname == "$hostname")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "in_octets")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derive(column: "_value", unit: 30s, keepFirst: false)

from(bucket: "stackhive-telemetry")
